knowledgeCases.reason: A real restart falsifier supports the boundary, but P2 remains active and the final evidence-aware recovery design is unresolved.

interfaceCases.candidateConclusion: Repeated generic execution friction means Runtime should absorb Finance and Workstation semantics into one central typed capability layer.

interfaceCases.candidateConclusion: After restart, absent Tool observation content means no prior step is proven complete, so recovery can restart from step zero.
